item.title: Washington Post cuts a third of its staff in a blow to a legendary news brand
item.description: The Washington Post has laid off one-third of its staff, eliminating its sports section, several foreign bureaus and its books coverage.

item.title: Man sentenced for sexually assaulting teen on Seattle flight
item.description: An Alaska man was sentenced to 18 months in federal prison for sexually assaulting a 17-year-old girl on a flight to Seattle.

item.title: WA's juvenile interrogation law faces scrutiny as teen homicides go unsolved
item.description: Seattle law enforcement and families of victims are questioning a WA law requiring legal counsel for minors before police questioning, citing it as a significant hurdle in high-profile teen homicides.

item.title: WA lawmakers push for workaround as businesses struggle to find pennies
item.description: With the penny slowly being “counted out," lawmakers in Washington state are working on a bill that would require businesses to round cash purchases to the nearest nickel.

item.title: Seattle Seahawks practice has full attendance, five players limited ahead of Super Bowl
item.description: Every player on the roster for the Seattle Seahawks was able to participate in Wednesday's practice ahead of Super Bowl LX, with only five players limited due to injury issues.

item.title: Bad Bunny records sold out across Seattle ahead of the Super Bowl
item.description: Spotify’s top global streaming artist of 2025 will be part of the spotlight this Sunday alongside the Seattle Seahawks, stirring response across the city.

item.title: Seattle Seahawks safety Nick Emmanwori leaves practice with ankle injury
item.description: Seattle Seahawks safety Nick Emmanwori had to leave practice early on Wednesday due to an ankle injury late in the session, according to a pool report from the Pro Football Writers' Association.

item.title: 'Lucky' WA pup adopted after being rescued from fentanyl overdose
item.description: The six puppies that could have died due to likely exposure to drugs in Snohomish County have found new homes.

item.title: Joel Foxwell's 27 points lead Portland to 87-80 upset of No. 6 Gonzaga
item.description: Joel Foxwell scored 27 points and Portland upset No. 6 Gonzaga 87-80 on Wednesday night, giving the Pilots their first victory over a top-10 team and snapping the Bulldogs' 15-game winning streak.

item.title: Shane Wright scores twice as Seattle Kraken beat Kings 4-2
item.description: Shane Wright scored twice to lead the Seattle Kraken to a 4-2 win over the Los Angeles Kings on Wednesday night.
